name: app-6a54b85a14f48191a8d2668b49d1f699
description: Discover restaurants and reserve tables with Swiggy Dineout in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Ask for a place to eat out the way you’d ask a friend: a cuisine, an area, a rooftop or live music, a time. Swiggy Dineout shows matching restaurants with their ratings and cost for two, checks open table slots at the one you pick for the day you want, and books your table once you confirm. Sign in with your Swiggy account to book.
defaultPrompt: Rooftop table for 4 in Indiranagar tonight at 8
Italian places in Koramangala for Saturday dinner
Book a table for 2 in Indiranagar tomorrow at 9 pm

positive.description: Find restaurants by cuisine and location
positive.prompt: Find South Indian restaurants near Koramangala, Bengaluru.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching restaurants in the requested area with names, ratings, cuisine, distance, and booking actions when available.

positive.prompt: Show me the details for the first restaurant from those results.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the selected restaurant's address, hours, rating, available offers, and reservation information.

positive.prompt: Check table availability for two people tonight at that restaurant.
positive.expected_behavior: Show available reservation slots for the requested party size and date, or clearly report when no slots are available.

positive.prompt: Reserve the 8:00 PM slot for two people using my signed-in Dineout account.
positive.expected_behavior: Complete the supported reservation flow only after confirmation and return the booking reference and status.

positive.prompt: Show the status of my latest Dineout booking.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the latest accessible booking status, restaurant, date, time, party size, and booking reference.

negative.prompt: Order a bag of rice for delivery.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use Dineout tools; explain that Dineout handles restaurant reservations and direct the user to the appropriate app experience.
Ask for a city or location before calling restaurant search.

negative.prompt: Change the email address on my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt the action; explain that account changes require the Swiggy app and guide the user there.

review.commerce_description: Dineout supports restaurant table reservations and supported payment flows for eligible bookings.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with restaurant discovery, details, table availability, reservations, booking status, payments, and error reporting.
